Protection
The younger you get insured, the better. Now that you've started earning, saving for the things that matter will be much easier without worrying about medical bills.
/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--61778a79-4b70-470b-aa50-7ad5c77a6ef4/what-you-already-have--2-.jpg?quality=85&preferwebp=true
What you already have¹
If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes:
MediSave A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement.
MediShield Life A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs.
CareShield Life Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability.
/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--fdd9715d-fd00-4069-b8ce-d7188540fb0d/what-you-may-consider--1-.jpg?quality=85&preferwebp=true
What you may consider²
Beyond the basic coverage from national schemes, you’ll still need to ensure that you are sufficiently covered to avoid dipping into any hard-earned savings.
National schemes do not fully cover:
Hospitalisation An Integrated Shield Plan (IP) provides additional coverage for private hospitals or higher ward classes in public hospitals.
Critical Illness You’ll need coverage of 4x annual income. (Recommended)³
Death & Total and Permanent Disability You’ll need coverage of 9 – 10x annual income. (Recommended)³
Make sure your insurance premiums fit comfortably within your budget. It’s recommended to spend at most 15% of take-home pay on insurance protection.

Wealth
Building your wealth early on is crucial as you’ll need to plan for the big-ticket items of tomorrow. Let your money work for you while you focus on the things that matter to you.
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/what_you_should_have-2?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1772445898949&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
Basics – what you should have³
Emergency Funds At least 3 – 6 months’ worth of expenses (including dependants) for rainy days.
/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--b34f9cdb-835d-45a2-af3a-b86d44cc3a8e/what-you-may-consider.jpg?quality=85&preferwebp=true
What you may consider
Savings for your upcoming expenses and a plan for you to live out your golden years comfortably – the earlier you start, the more time you have to grow your wealth and accumulate more.
Investments It is recommended to allocate at least 10%3 of your take-home pay for key milestones.
A Retirement Plan³ It is never too early to start building your nest egg for the retirement lifestyle you want, including monthly payouts.
Why act now
/adobe/dynamicmedia/deliver/dm-aid--611f885d-d133-4cee-87f8-15a9f97b0565/why-act-now.jpg?quality=85&preferwebp=true
The earlier you start, the longer time horizon you’ll have to accumulate wealth due to the compounding effect⁴.
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/why_act_now_1-5?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1784630147928&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
As lifespans are increasing⁵, you’ll need a plan for your financial needs in the future.
